title: Something went wrong
generic: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

codes.unauthorized: The engine rejected the access token. Restart Levelset.
codes.validation_error: Some values are not valid. Please check and try again.
codes.scan_failed: The scan couldn't get market data. Try again in a moment.
codes.news_failed: Couldn't load the news right now. Try again in a moment.
codes.insufficient_position: You don't hold enough shares to sell that quantity.
codes.invalid_alert: This alert isn't valid. Check the type and the level or time.
codes.sec_identity_missing: SEC needs your name and email first. Add them in Settings › Data & SEC.
codes.no_sec_filer: SEC has no reported numbers for this ticker (ETFs and many foreign companies don't file them).
codes.analyst_failed: Couldn't reach SEC EDGAR right now. Try again in a moment.
codes.congress_failed: Couldn't reach the House Clerk's disclosure site. Try again in a moment.
codes.ai_disabled: AI is off. Turn it on in Settings › AI.
codes.ai_no_key: No Claude API key yet. Add one in Settings › AI.
codes.ai_cap_reached: You reached this month's AI spending cap. Raise it in Settings › AI or wait for next month.
codes.ai_failed: The Claude API request failed. Check your key and connection, then try again.
codes.invalid_ai_key: That doesn't look like a Claude API key.
